AdminUserPatchBody.description: Source `adminUserPatchInput`: at least one of the flags.

BrandingAsset.description:
The identity the upload route recorded: storage key, digest, sniffed type.
Serving checks the digest, so a hand-written key cannot turn this public
route into a reader for another object.

ConsentItemBody.description: Items are non-strict objects in the source (extra keys are ignored).

DocumentShareLinkCreateBody.description: Source `wikiShareLinkCreateInput`: the document comes from the path.

InstanceSettingsPatchInput.description:
OpenAPI shape of `PATCH /admin/instance-settings`: every key optional,
`null` resets it; `branding` has no asset leaves. The server validates the
raw JSON against the catalog.

PatchMeBody.description:
OpenAPI request-body schema for PATCH /api/v1/auth/me.
Runtime parsing uses [`crate::http::json_input::parse_patch_me`].

familyName.description: Omitted preserves the current value; JSON `null` clears it.

PublicBrandingOutput.description: Public branding: asset delivery paths, never storage keys.

SettingsValues.description: The effective value of every key (serialized as the admin `values`).

url.description: Public page URL carrying the raw token; shown once.

SharePolicy.description:
Instance share-link policy. Share-link routes read it through
[`crate::settings::share_policy`].

WebhookCreatedOutput.description: Returned once, on creation: the signing secret is never readable again.

WithdrawBody.description:
POST /auth/withdraw. Source `withdrawInput`: a non-null `currentPassword`
wins; otherwise `emailLocalPart` (password-less accounts).
